input: Draft a termination clause for my freelance contract

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Termination Clause for Freelance Contract
gold.taskDescription: Draft a termination clause tailored to the user's freelance contract situation.

questions.title: Which party are you in this contract, client or freelancer?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is the one hiring or the one being hired, as this affects whose protections the clause should prioritize.

questions.title: What type of freelance work does this contract cover?
questions.description: Identify the nature of the work (e.g., design, writing, software development, consulting) to ensure the clause uses relevant language.

questions.title: What notice period do you want before termination takes effect?
questions.description: Determine the required advance notice window (e.g., 7, 14, or 30 days) for either party to terminate the agreement.

questions.title: Should termination be allowed without cause, or only for cause?
questions.description: Clarify whether either party can exit at will or only under specific breach or failure conditions.

questions.title: How should payment for work-in-progress be handled at termination?
questions.description: Establish rules for compensating partially completed work, such as pro-rated pay or milestone-based settlement.

questions.title: Which country or state law governs this contract?
questions.description: Identify the governing jurisdiction so the clause is legally compliant with the relevant employment or contract law.

questions.title: Should the clause include an immediate termination option for misconduct?
questions.description: Determine whether a cause-based instant termination provision (with no notice period) should be included for serious breaches.
